daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

President Prabowo Subianto led the Pancasila Sanctity Day ceremony at Lubang Buaya on 1 October 2026, accompanied by Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka and DPR Speaker Puan Maharani. The president prayed at the well site where heroes of the revolution were killed in 1965, while moments of cordiality with Puan were observed during the ceremony. In a major development, Prabowo sent a presidential decree dismissing National Police Chief General Listyo Sigit.

  • The Constitutional Court continued hearing evidence in the dispute over Gibran's candidacy requirements, with witnesses claiming rogue KPU officials inserted provisions into regulations.
  • Former Vice President Mahfud MD proposed a joint faction in the DPR after 17 million votes were wasted in the 2024 election.
  • The DPR announced that the traffic bill will regulate taxes on online transport firms.
  • A DPR member stated there is no place for special privileges after a luxury house for inmates at Cibinong prison was demolished, with the Ministry acknowledging inmates enjoyed luxury facilities.
  • The MBG corruption case entered a new phase as Dadan Hindayana and others are set to be tried, with an active TNI member named as a suspect.
  • The KPK alleged that Silmy Karim routinely gave money to lecturers at Brawijaya University.
  • Gus Ipul issued summons to three people over allegations of money flows at the NU Congress.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia awarded military honors to 361 Japanese disaster relief personnel who completed a mission using three Chinook helicopters to combat forest fires. The Japanese force dropped 220 tons of water during the operation and received the Satyalancana medal for their efforts.

  • Indonesia seeks Swiss cooperation on water, energy, and connectivity projects.
  • The Deputy Minister for Migrant Worker Protection stated that Singapore's commitment opens opportunities to strengthen protection for Indonesian migrant workers.

Other

President Prabowo called for the 2027 state budget to maximize public welfare during budget discussions. The government announced a shift in social assistance delivery, with Coordinating Minister Luhut Pandjaitan stating the administration is shifting social aid and subsidies to cash, while targeting 48 million families for digital social assistance. The government also announced it will provide wage assistance to 13.3 million workers, paying Rp 900,000 over three months.

  • Bank Indonesia and the government strengthened synergy to address the deficit and stabilize the rupiah.
  • The Ministry adjusted MBG kitchen incentives from Rp 6 million per day to Rp 2,000 per portion, while announcing the program will serve fish menu twice a week.
  • Indonesia targets EV battery and BESS expansion in phase two of downstream development, and is developing 15 solar plants under a 100GWp program.
  • The government sees 114 percent US tariff potential to boost the solar panel market.
  • BRIN warned of potential Super El Niño 2026-2027 and prolonged drought.
  • The Constitutional Court issued a ruling on sugar, salt, and fat labeling favoring consumer health.
